note: Whitney Lakes Provincial Park's Whitney Lake campground, with a natural sand beach and boat launch. Most sites take long rigs; sites 23 and 24 are 21 ft. The sani-dump and the Ross Lake camp store are a short drive away; the park's shower building is at Ross Lake. --Claude
